label: Primary email private
means: Whether the account's primary email has visibility private.
goal_source: GitHub Docs, Setting your commit email address (https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/setting-up-and-managing-your-personal-account-on-github/managing-email-preferences/setting-your-commit-email-address, read 2026-11-26); GitHub Docs, REST API endpoints for emails (https://docs.github.com/en/rest/users/emails, read 2026-11-26)
source: state: gh api user/emails: visibility of the primary address; needs the user:email scope (gh auth refresh -s user:email)

params.comment: owner: the GitHub user read; empty means the signed-in user. Private settings answer only the signed-in user.

label: Personal emails in recent commits
means: Distinct non-noreply author emails in the latest 100 public commits. A count, never an address.
goal_source: GitHub Docs, Blocking command line pushes that expose your personal email address (https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/setting-up-and-managing-your-personal-account-on-github/managing-email-preferences/blocking-command-line-pushes-that-expose-your-personal-email-address, read 2026-11-26); template goal: none
source: last 100 events: gh api search/commits?q=author:<login>&sort=author-date, the newest 100; new commits replace old within hours

label: One read
means: Seconds this tab's collector takes to read the account's email settings and recent commits.
goal_source: GitHub Docs, Best practices for using the REST API (https://docs.github.com/en/rest/using-the-rest-api/best-practices-for-using-the-rest-api, read 2026-11-26), asks for serial requests; template goal: a few serial reads finish in seconds
source: wall time of this tab's collector, first request to last

label: API requests per read
means: gh api requests one read of the account's email settings and recent commits spends.
goal_source: GitHub Docs, Rate limits for the REST API (https://docs.github.com/en/rest/using-the-rest-api/rate-limits-for-the-rest-api, read 2026-11-26): GITHUB_TOKEN gets 1,000 requests per hour per repository; template goal: one read spends a hundredth of that
source: gh api requests this tab's collector made, one per page
